$comment: Compass Core table ownership (issue #1329). Each table listed here is read AND written only inside its owning domain module; everything else calls that module. Enforced by eslint-rules/compass-core. Keys are the Drizzle export names, values the SQL table names.

identity.hint: Signed-in user/org: userContext / orgContext from @/lib/server/action-context. Anything else: use or add a read function in src/lib/domain/identity/.

project.hint: Access check: projectContext from @/lib/server/action-context, or assertProjectAccess from @/lib/project-access. Member lists: use or add a read function in src/lib/domain/project/.

contacts.hint: Project contacts: resolvedProjectContacts from @/lib/domain/contacts/resolved-project-contacts. Directory people and companies: use or add a function in src/lib/domain/contacts/.

roles.$comment: Role logic lives in one place. Literal role comparisons are allowed only in these paths.
roles.hint: Use a named role predicate from @/lib/user-roles (isInternalStaffRole, isExternalProjectRole, ...). If none fits, add one there.
